discovery: macOS launcher --check-update only suppresses HTTPError 404; other urllib errors propagate through main() and surface as /api/launcher/check-update HTTP 500 via call_launcher_command.
/api/launcher/check-update gates on LAUNCHER_MANAGED, then call_launcher_command returns HTTP 500 with detail launcher executable missing when INFINITE_CANVAS_LAUNCHER_EXE is empty or nonexistent.

macOS check-update calls resolve_runtime_context then read_manifest without a management-action try/except; missing manifest, missing app-base.zip, corrupt manifest, or corrupt app-base.zip can raise before remote fetch and make the launcher subprocess exit non-zero.
